props.colorScheme: Color scheme: "default" or the name of any `--color-<name>-50` … 950 palette. Unset, it inherits from the parent element.
props.portalColorScheme: Color scheme for the content. Content renders in a portal, so it can't inherit a scheme from the trigger's parents.
props.variant: Visual style. Colors come from the color scheme.
props.disabled: Prevents interaction and dims the component.
props.label: Text shown next to the control, rendered with Label. Without it, pass aria-label.
props.ariaLabel: Accessible name, for when there is no visible label.
props.defaultOpen: Open state on first render, when uncontrolled.
props.onOpenChange: Called with the new open state when it changes.
props.modal: When true, blocks interaction with the rest of the page while open.
props.openDelay: Milliseconds before it opens on hover.
props.closeDelay: Milliseconds before it closes after the pointer leaves.
props.block: Fill the full width of the parent.
props.gap: Space between items, from none to xl.
props.layoutAsChild: Render the child element (e.g. `<ul>` or `<section>`) as the container instead of a `<div>`.
props.className: Extra classes, merged last with tw() so they override the component's own.
props.onClick: Called when the component is clicked.
props.onCheckedChange: Called with the new checked state when it changes.
props.onValueChange: Called with the new value when it changes.
props.placeholder: Hint text shown while the field is empty.
props.defaultValue: Initial value when uncontrolled (no value prop).
props.step: Amount the value changes by per step.
props.sideOffset: Distance in pixels between the trigger and the content.

Accolades.description: A looping carousel of accolades (logo, quote and link, each optional) that advances one item at a time and snaps into place. Pauses while hovered or focused, has a pause button, and starts paused for reduced-motion users. Shows 1, 2 or 3 items depending on the window width. Needs the optional peer dependencies embla-carousel-react and embla-carousel-autoplay; import it from "another-react-tailwind-component-library/accolades".

props.loop: Wrap from the last item back to the first.
props.slideLabel: Accessible name for each item, from its position and the total. Defaults to "1 of 5".
props.pauseLabel: Accessible name of the button while playing.
props.playLabel: Accessible name of the button while paused.
props.animation: How items enter and leave the view: none, fade, or pop (fade plus a slight scale).

story.label: What customers say
quotes: The components dropped straight into our design system. We shipped the redesign in half the time.
Accessible by default, themeable without a fight. Exactly what we needed.
Our team stopped arguing about button styles. That alone was worth it.
Clean APIs, sensible defaults, and the CSS variables make theming painless.
We replaced three internal libraries with this one.

Accordion.description: Vertically stacked headings that each reveal a section of content.

props.type: "single" opens one item at a time; "multiple" allows several.
props.collapsible: With type "single", lets the open item be closed again.

story.answer1: Yes. It follows the WAI-ARIA pattern.

cssVariables.--accordion-padding-y: Vertical padding of triggers and content

ActionCard.description: A Card that is one big link or button: hovering lifts it and zooms its image (use ActionCardImage). Compose it with CardHeader and CardDescription; it has no footer.

props.href: Link destination. With href the card is an `<a>`; without it, a button that calls onClick.
props.target: Link target, e.g. "_blank". Only with href.
props.rel: Link rel, e.g. "noopener". Only with href.
props.onClick: Called when the card is clicked or activated with Enter or Space.
props.asChild: Render the child element (e.g. a router Link) as the card. Put the card content inside it.

story.description: Seven days of trails, huts and glaciers, with a guide for every route.

AlertDialog.description: A modal dialog that interrupts the user and asks them to confirm an action. AlertDialogAction and AlertDialogCancel render Button.

Anchor.description: A styled link. Inherits the surrounding font size. Use asChild to style a router link (e.g. React Router's Link).

props.underline: When the underline shows: always, on hover, or never.
props.asChild: Render the child element (e.g. a router Link) with anchor styles instead of an `<a>`.

AnimatedContainer.description: Animates its direct children in when the container first scrolls into view. Use asChild to animate the items of a FlexContainer, GridContainer or list. Respects reduced-motion settings.

props.animation: Entrance animation: fade, or pop (fade plus a slight scale-up).
props.stagger: Start each child a little after the previous one.
props.staggerDelay: Delay between children in milliseconds when stagger is on. Overrides --animated-container-stagger-delay.

AspectRatio.description: Keeps its child at a set width-to-height ratio. Unstyled.

Avatar.description: An image of a person, with a fallback (usually initials) while it loads or if it fails. Turn on badge for a status dot or a count on its edge; use AvatarBadge directly for a custom one.

props.badge: Show a badge on the avatar's edge.
props.badgeContent: Text in the badge, such as a notification count ("3", "99+"). Empty shows a dot.
props.badgeLabel: Accessible name of the badge, such as "Online" or "3 new messages". Needed for a dot, which has no text.

cssVariables.--avatar-badge-inset: AvatarBadge distance in from the avatar's corner (14.6% puts it on a circle's edge; use 0% for square avatars)
cssVariables.--avatar-badge-ring: Ring color around the AvatarBadge, separating it from the image

Badge.description: A small label for a status, category or count.

props.asChild: Render the child element (e.g. a link) with badge styles instead of a `<span>`.

Button.description: Triggers an action. Style with variant, color with colorScheme.

props.asChild: Render the child element (e.g. a link) with button styles instead of a `<button>`.

ButtonGroup.description: Joins related buttons (Button or IconButton) into one control, side by side or stacked. Only the outer corners are rounded, and the group's variant and size apply to every button unless a button sets its own.

props.variant: Variant for every button in the group. A button's own variant wins.
props.size: Size for every button in the group. A button's own size wins.
props.orientation: Lay the buttons out side by side (horizontal) or stacked (vertical).

cssVariables.--button-group-overlap: How far neighbouring buttons overlap, so outline borders don't double
cssVariables.--button-group-divider: Line between solid and soft buttons

Card.description: A container for one subject, with an optional cover image, header, description and footer. Compose only the sections you need; spacing adjusts to what's there.

props.asChild: Card: render the child element (e.g. a link) as the card instead of a `<div>`. CardImage, CardHeader, CardDescription and CardFooter take it too.

story.description: The new release is ready for review. Check the changes and approve it to publish.

cssVariables.padding: Padding around the header, description and footer
cssVariables.--card-container-padding: Space between the card edge and the cover image

Checkbox.description: A control that toggles between checked and unchecked, with an optional indeterminate state.

props.icon: Icon shown when checked. Defaults to Radix CheckIcon.
props.indeterminateIcon: Icon shown when checked is "indeterminate". Defaults to Radix MinusIcon.

cssVariables.--checkbox-gap: Space between the box and its label

Code.description: Inline code, such as a command or a function name. Sizes are relative to the surrounding text.

props.copyable: Show a button that copies the code.
props.copyLabel: Accessible name of the copy button.
props.copiedLabel: Accessible name of the copy button after copying.

cssVariables.copy-gap: Space between the code and its copy button

CodeBlock.description: A block of preformatted code with a copy button. Long lines scroll horizontally.

props.copyable: Show a button that copies the code.
props.copyLabel: Accessible name of the copy button.
props.copiedLabel: Accessible name of the copy button after copying.

Collapsible.description: A section that expands and collapses. Unstyled: style the trigger and content yourself. Content animates its height.

story.content: Hidden details, revealed with a height animation.

Container.description: Centers page content. Its maximum width steps up with Tailwind's breakpoints (full width on small screens, then 40rem, 48rem, 64rem, 80rem, 96rem), and its side padding grows on larger screens.

story.children: Page content stays centered and stops growing at the container's maximum width.

ContextMenu.description: A menu that opens on right-click (or long-press) over its trigger area.

Dialog.description: A modal window over the page. DialogContent includes a close button unless showClose is false.

props.closeLabel: DialogContent: accessible name of the close button.

story.title: Edit profile
story.description: Changes are saved when you click Save.

cssVariables.--dialog-gap: Space between header, body and footer

DropdownMenu.description: A menu of actions or options that opens from a button.

FlexContainer.description: A Container that lays out its children with flexbox: centered and width-limited like Container (adjusting to the window), with flex direction, alignment and gap.

props.direction: Main axis: row or column, optionally reversed.
props.wrap: Whether items wrap onto new lines.
props.columns: Up to that many items per row, wrapping to fewer as the container narrows. Items in a short last row grow to fill it.
props.minColumnWidth: Narrowest a column may get before the layout drops to fewer columns (any CSS length). Default 15rem.

GridContainer.description: A Container that lays out its children in a CSS grid: centered and width-limited like Container (adjusting to the window), with columns, rows and gap.

props.columns: A number: up to that many equal columns, dropping to fewer as the container narrows. A string: any grid-template-columns value (e.g. "200px 1fr"), used as is.
props.rows: A number for that many equal rows, or any grid-template-rows value.
props.align: Vertical alignment of items in their cells (align-items).
props.justify: Horizontal alignment of items in their cells (justify-items).
props.flow: How auto-placed items fill the grid (grid-auto-flow).
props.minColumnWidth: Narrowest a column may get before the layout drops to fewer columns (any CSS length). Default 15rem.

Hero.description: The opening section of a page: a title, description and actions next to an image, or, with full, on top of it as a background. The content is wrapped in a Container. Padding, height and text sizes grow with the window; below the md breakpoint the side-by-side layout stacks.

props.full: Show the image as a full-width background with the text on top, instead of side by side.

story.title: Build interfaces faster
story.description: Accessible React components styled with Tailwind CSS. Theme them with a color scheme and a few CSS variables.

HoverCard.description: A preview card that appears when a pointer hovers over a link.

IconButton.description: A square Button that holds a single icon, such as settings or close. It has the same variants, sizes and states as Button, and lines up with it in a row. aria-label is required, since the icon has no visible text.

props.aria-label: Accessible name, e.g. "Settings". Required: the icon has no visible text.
props.round: Make the button a circle instead of a rounded square.
props.asChild: Render the child element (e.g. a link) with icon button styles instead of a `<button>`. Put the icon inside it.
props.children: The icon, e.g. a Radix icon with aria-hidden.

Image.description: An image with a placeholder: if src is missing or fails to load, it shows an icon (or your fallback) in the same box.

props.alt: Text alternative. Leave empty for decorative images.
props.fit: How the image fills its box (CSS object-fit).
props.aspectRatio: Box aspect ratio, e.g. "16 / 9" or 1. Keeps the space reserved while loading and for the fallback.
props.fallback: Shown instead of the image when src is missing or fails. Defaults to Radix ImageIcon.
props.zoomOnHover: Zoom the image inside its frame on hover (and keyboard focus).
props.openInDialog: Make the image a button that opens it full size in a Dialog.
props.dialogSrc: Image shown in the dialog, e.g. a higher-resolution version. Defaults to src.
props.openLabel: Accessible name of the image button and dialog when alt is empty.
props.closeLabel: Accessible name of the dialog's close button.

ImageGallery.description: A grid of image and video thumbnails. Clicking one opens a lightbox showing it full size, with previous and next buttons, a counter and the arrow keys to step through the gallery (wrapping at the ends). Videos play with controls. The grid drops columns as space runs out, like GridContainer.

props.items: The images and videos, in order: `{ src, alt, thumbnail? }` for an image, `{ type: "video", src, label, poster? }` for a video.
props.columns: Most thumbnails per row; fewer when they'd get narrower than minColumnWidth.
props.minColumnWidth: Narrowest a thumbnail may get before the grid uses fewer columns (any CSS length).
props.aspectRatio: Thumbnail aspect ratio, e.g. "4 / 3" or 1. The lightbox shows each item at its own shape.
props.zoomOnHover: Zoom thumbnails inside their frame on hover.
props.closeLabel: Accessible name of the lightbox's close button.
props.previousLabel: Accessible name of the lightbox's previous button.
props.nextLabel: Accessible name of the lightbox's next button.

alts: Green hills under a blue sky

InputGroup.description: Joins inputs and buttons side by side into one control: TextInput, NumberInput, SelectTrigger, Button and IconButton. Only the outer corners are rounded, borders don't double up, and the group's size applies to every control unless it sets its own. Text inputs stretch to fill the row; number inputs, selects and buttons keep their width (set a NumberInput's width with className). Label the group (aria-label) or each control rather than using built-in labels inside it.

props.size: Size for every control in the group. A control's own size wins.
props.block: Fill the full width of the parent.

cssVariables.--input-group-overlap: How far neighbouring controls overlap, so borders don't double

Label.description: Text that names a form control. Clicking it focuses or toggles the control.

props.htmlFor: id of the control this label names.

ListingCard.description: A listing such as a product or rental: an image with an optional badge, a title with a price, a subtitle, details (children) and action buttons at the bottom, such as Add to cart.

props.title: Listing name.
props.imageSrc: Image URL. Omit for no image.
props.imageAlt: Image alt text. Empty by default, since the title describes the listing.
props.badge: Short label over the image's top-left corner, e.g. "New".
props.badgeProps: Props for the Badge, e.g. variant or colorScheme. Defaults to the soft variant.
props.price: Price, as displayed (e.g. "$180"), at the right of the title.
props.unit: Unit shown after the price as "/unit" (e.g. "night").
props.subtitle: Secondary line under the title, e.g. a location.
props.children: Details shown in a wrapping row, e.g. guests, bedrooms and amenities.
props.actions: Buttons at the bottom, e.g. Add to cart. Use Button's block prop for a full-width button.

Menubar.description: A horizontal bar of menus, like an application's File and Edit menus.

NavigationMenu.description: Site navigation links, with optional panels that open below the list.

NumberInput.description: A number field with up and down buttons. It has everything TextInput has: variants, sizes, icons, a built-in label (top, left or border) and the required star. The buttons and the arrow keys respect min, max and step.

props.min: Lowest value the buttons and arrow keys step to.
props.max: Highest value the buttons and arrow keys step to.
props.step: Amount each button press or arrow key changes the value by.
props.incrementIcon: Icon for the increase button. Defaults to Radix ChevronUpIcon.
props.decrementIcon: Icon for the decrease button. Defaults to Radix ChevronDownIcon.
props.incrementLabel: Accessible name of the increase button.
props.decrementLabel: Accessible name of the decrease button.
props.hideSteppers: Hide the up and down buttons; the arrow keys still step.
props.label: Visible label, linked to the input. Without one, pass aria-label instead.
props.labelPlacement: Where the label sits: "top" (above the field), "left" (beside it) or "border" (on the top border, Material style).
props.required: Marks the field as required: adds the required attribute and a star after the label.
props.prependElement: Shown before the input, usually an icon.
props.appendElement: Shown after the input and before the buttons, usually a unit or an icon.

PhoneInput.description: A phone number field: a calling-code select (showing "+1") joined to a field that formats the number as you type for the selected country, e.g. (555) 555-5555. The value it reports and submits is unformatted E.164, e.g. +15555555555. Every country formats in its own style (India 098765 43210, Japan 090-1234-5678), digits typed in other scripts (Arabic-Indic, Persian, Devanagari, full-width) are understood, and pasting an international number picks its country. Needs the optional peer dependency libphonenumber-js; import it from "another-react-tailwind-component-library/phone-input".

props.value: Phone number in E.164 format (e.g. "+15555555555"), when controlled.
props.defaultValue: Initial phone number in E.164 format, when uncontrolled.
props.onValueChange: Called with the E.164 number as the user types, or "" when empty.
props.name: Form field name. The form submits the unformatted E.164 number under it.
props.countries: Countries in the calling-code select: `{ code, dialCode, name }` objects, e.g. `{ code: "US", dialCode: "+1", name: "United States" }`. Replaces the default list (defaultPhoneCountries, about 50 countries from every region). Use getPhoneCountries(locale) for all ~245, with names in any language.
props.defaultCountry: ISO code of the country selected at first, e.g. "GB". Ignored when value or defaultValue sets one.
props.onCountryChange: Called with the country when the user picks another one (or pastes a number from another country).
props.label: Visible label, linked to the number field.
props.required: Marks the number as required: adds the required attribute and a star after the label.
props.countryLabel: Accessible name of the calling-code select.

cssVariables.--phone-input-label-gap: Space between the label and the field

Popover.description: Floating content anchored to a trigger, opened by clicking it.

PriceCard.description: A pricing plan: a title with an optional badge, the price and its unit ("$29 /month"), your own content (usually a feature list), and a full-width button. Built on Card, so it takes Card's variant.

props.title: Plan name.
props.badge: Short label at the top right, such as "Most popular". Omit for none.
props.badgeProps: Props for the Badge, such as variant or colorScheme. Defaults to the soft variant.
props.unit: Billing unit shown after the price as "/unit" (e.g. "month"). Omit for a one-off price.
props.buttonProps: Props for the Button, such as onClick, variant, or asChild with a link.
props.children: Custom content between the price and the button, usually a feature list.

ProfileCard.description: A person at a glance: a large avatar, their name and role, an optional bio (children) and optional actions. Built on Card and Avatar.

props.name: Person's name. Also used for the fallback initials.
props.subtitle: Role, title or handle, shown under the name.
props.avatarSrc: Avatar image URL. Without one (or while it loads), the fallback shows.
props.avatarAlt: Avatar image alt text. Empty by default, since the name is shown next to it.
props.avatarFallback: Shown when there's no image. Defaults to the initials of name.
props.avatarProps: Props for the Avatar, e.g. badge, badgeContent or colorScheme.
props.actions: Buttons or links shown at the bottom, e.g. Follow and Message. They share the full width equally.
props.children: Bio or other text under the subtitle.

story.name: Jordan Lee
story.subtitle: Product designer
story.bio: Designs calm, accessible interfaces. Previously at two tiny startups and one big one.

Progress.description: Shows how far a task has progressed.

props.value: Current progress, from 0 to max. Leave unset when the amount is unknown.

Radio.description: A set of options where only one can be selected. RadioGroup passes size and icon to its Radios.

props.size: Size of every Radio in the group.
props.icon: Default checked icon for every Radio in the group. Radio's own icon prop overrides it.

cssVariables.--radio-gap: Space between the circle and its label
cssVariables.--radio-group-gap: Space between radios in a group

ScrollArea.description: A scrollable area with custom, themeable scrollbars.

Select.description: Picks one value from a list. The trigger matches TextInput's variants and sizes.

cssVariables.--select-gap: Space between the value and the chevron

Separator.description: A line that separates content, horizontally or vertically.

props.decorative: Purely visual: hidden from screen readers. Set false when it separates meaningful sections.

Slider.description: Picks a value, or a range, by dragging along a track. Renders one thumb per value.

props.aria-label: Accessible name, applied to every thumb.

Switch.description: A control that turns a setting on or off.

cssVariables.--switch-gap: Space between the switch and its label

Tabs.description: Sections of content shown one at a time, chosen from a row of tabs.

cssVariables.--tabs-gap: Space between the tab list and content

TextInput.description: A single-line text field for text, email, search or URL input, with an optional built-in label: above the field, beside it, or on its top border. Required fields get a star after the label.

props.type: Input type. Only text, email, search and url are allowed; anything else falls back to text.
props.prependElement: Shown before the input, usually an icon.
props.appendElement: Shown after the input, usually an icon.
props.label: Visible label, linked to the input. Without one, pass aria-label instead.
props.labelPlacement: Where the label sits: "top" (above the field), "left" (beside it) or "border" (on the top border, Material style).
props.required: Marks the field as required: adds the required attribute and a star after the label.

cssVariables.--text-input-label-gap: Space between the label and the field (top and left placements)
cssVariables.--text-input-label-overlap: Room above the field for a border label
cssVariables.--text-input-label-inset: Border label distance from the field's left edge
cssVariables.--text-input-label-surface: Background behind a border label: match it to the page or container
cssVariables.--text-input-label-width: Width of a left label. Set the same width on a form's fields so they line up.

Toast.description: A short, temporary message. Place a ToastProvider and ToastViewport once in the app. ToastAction renders Button.

Toggle.description: A button that stays pressed or unpressed.

ToggleGroup.description: A set of toggles where one or several can be pressed. variant and size apply to every item.

props.type: "single" allows one pressed item; "multiple" allows several.

Toolbar.description: A row of buttons, toggles and links. Buttons use the Toggle styles.

props.size: Size of buttons and toggles in the toolbar.

Tooltip.description: A short label that appears on hover or focus. Wrap the app (or a section) in TooltipProvider once.

props.side: Preferred side of the trigger to show on.
props.showArrow: Show the arrow pointing at the trigger.

Typography.description: Styled text. Renders a `<span>` by default; use asChild to style another element such as a heading or paragraph.

props.font: Font family: Roboto (sans), Roboto Serif (serif) or Roboto Mono (mono).
props.size: Font size and line height, from xxs to xxl.
props.asChild:
Render the child element (e.g. an `

` or `

`) with typography styles instead of a ``.

story.children: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

Video.description: A video that works like Image: a placeholder if src is missing or fails to load, optional zoom on hover, and openInDialog, which turns it into a preview with a play button that plays the video full size in a dialog.

props.poster: Image shown before the video plays.
props.label: Accessible name (videos have no alt text). Also names the play button and dialog.
props.fit: How the video fills its box (CSS object-fit).
props.aspectRatio: Box aspect ratio, e.g. "16 / 9". Keeps the space reserved while loading and for the fallback.
props.fallback: Shown instead of the video when src is missing or fails. Defaults to Radix VideoIcon.
props.controls: Show the browser's playback controls inline. Ignored with openInDialog, where the dialog shows them.
props.muted: Start muted. Browsers only autoplay muted videos.
props.loop: Start again from the beginning when it ends.
props.zoomOnHover: Zoom the video inside its frame on hover (and keyboard focus).
props.openInDialog: Show a preview with a play button; clicking it plays the video full size in a Dialog.
props.dialogSrc: Video played in the dialog, e.g. a higher-quality version. Defaults to src.
props.openLabel: Accessible name of the play button and dialog when there's no label.
props.closeLabel: Accessible name of the dialog's close button.

PasswordInput.description: A password field with a button that shows and hides what's typed, built on Radix PasswordToggleField. It has everything TextInput has: variants, sizes, icons, a built-in label (top, left or border) and the required star. Submitting or resetting the form hides the password again.

props.autoComplete: Tells password managers what to fill: "current-password" to sign in, "new-password" to sign up or change it.
props.visible: Whether the password is shown, when controlled.
props.defaultVisible: Whether the password starts shown, when uncontrolled.
props.onVisibilityChange: Called with the new visibility when the toggle is pressed or the form is submitted or reset.
props.visibleIcon: Toggle icon while the password is shown.
props.hiddenIcon: Toggle icon while the password is hidden.
props.showLabel: Accessible name of the toggle while the password is hidden.
props.hideLabel: Accessible name of the toggle while the password is shown.
props.label: Visible label, linked to the input. Without one, pass aria-label instead.
props.labelPlacement: Where the label sits: "top" (above the field), "left" (beside it) or "border" (on the top border, Material style).
props.required: Marks the field as required: adds the required attribute and a star after the label.
props.prependElement: Shown before the input, usually an icon.
props.appendElement: Shown after the input and before the toggle.

OneTimeCodeInput.description: A one-time code field with one box per character, built on Radix OneTimePasswordField. Typing moves to the next box, Backspace to the previous one, and pasting or the browser's SMS autofill fills every box. The boxes share TextInput's variants, sizes and variables.

props.length: Number of characters, one box each.
props.validationType: Characters accepted: "numeric", "alpha", "alphanumeric" or "none" (use sanitizeValue for your own rule).
props.masked: Hide the characters like a password.
props.autoSubmit: Submit the form once every box is filled.
props.onAutoSubmit: Called with the code just before the automatic submit.
props.name: Name the code is submitted under with the form.
props.placeholder: Placeholder text, one character per box (e.g. "000000").
props.label: Visible label for the group of boxes. Without one, pass aria-label instead.
props.labelPlacement: Where the label sits: "top" (above the boxes) or "left" (beside them).
props.required: Marks the code as required and adds a star after the label.
props.cellLabel: Builds each box's accessible name from its position and the length.

cssVariables.--one-time-code-input-label-gap: Space between the label and the boxes
cssVariables.--one-time-code-input-label-width: Width of a left label. Set the same width on a form's fields so they line up.

cssVariables.intro: Override any of these in your CSS, globally or for a section, e.g. :root { --button-radius: 9999px; }. Defaults that use a scheme shade follow the component's color scheme.

suffixes.checked-bg-hover: Background color on hover when checked
suffixes.text-transform: Text case, e.g. uppercase or none
suffixes.focus-offset: Gap between the component and its focus ring
suffixes.indicator-scale: Scale of the check or dot icon
suffixes.item-highlight-bg: Item background when highlighted by pointer or keyboard
suffixes.item-hover-bg: Item background on hover or when open
suffixes.description-gap: Space between the header and the description
suffixes.min-column-width: Narrowest a column may get before the layout uses fewer columns
suffixes.underline-offset: Distance between the text and its underline
suffixes.pop-scale: Starting scale of the pop animation
suffixes.content-gap: Space between the title, description and actions
suffixes.item-basis: Width of each item, as a share of the carousel
suffixes.controls-gap: Space between the items and the pause button
suffixes.animation-duration: Length of the fade or pop
suffixes.animation-easing: Timing function of the fade or pop
suffixes.badge-size: AvatarBadge size when it has content (always a circle)
suffixes.zoom-scale: How far the image zooms on hover
suffixes.badge-inset: Badge distance from the image's corner
suffixes.stepper-height: Height of the up/down button pair
suffixes.stepper-inset: How far the buttons reach into the field's right padding
suffixes.toggle-inset: How far the show/hide button reaches into the field's right padding
suffixes.toggle-bg-hover: Show/hide button background on hover or focus

parts.menu-content: Menu (shared with DropdownMenu, ContextMenu, Menubar and Select)
parts.toggle: Toggle (shared with Toggle, ToggleGroup and Toolbar)
parts.container: Container (shared with Container, FlexContainer and GridContainer)
